outgoing.name: Carl Friedrich Gauss
outgoing.excerpt: He allowed the prominent mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss to name the asteroid after the Roman virgin goddess of home and hearth, Vesta.

outgoing.name: Crust (geology)
outgoing.excerpt: Vesta is thought to consist of a metallic iron-nickel core, an overlying rocky olivine mantle, with a surface crust.

outgoing.name: Germany
outgoing.excerpt: Vesta was discovered by the German astronomer Heinrich Wilhelm Olbers on March 29, 1807.
